title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Financial Market Infrastructure and Other Measures) Act 2024 (No. 87, 2024), Schedule 4 sustainability reporting
citation: Act No. 87 of 2024, Royal Assent 17 September 2024; Schedule 4 amends the Corporations Act 2001 (sustainability reports)
evidence: Commencement table in the Act as made: "14. Schedules 4 and 5 | The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent. | 18 September 2024"; sections 1 to 3 commenced on Royal Assent, 17 September 2024. Opened https://api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1/documents/find(titleId='C2024A00087',asAtSpecification='AsMade',...) on 2026-11-02.
notes: The Register lists the version from 2024-09-17 (Royal Assent); in_force here is the commencement of Schedule 4. Schedule 4 inserts ss 292A and 296A to 296E into the Corporations Act (stored as au-corporations-act-2001-pt2m3). Duties first apply to financial years starting on or after 2025-01-01 (Part 10.77). One version only: the Register serves no compilation of an amending Act.

title: Corporations Act 2001, sustainability reporting (ss 292A, 296A to 296E and Part 10.77 application and transitional provisions)
citation: Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) Chapter 2M Part 2M.3 Division 1 ss 292A, 296A-296E; Chapter 10 Part 10.77, inserted by Act No. 87 of 2024 Sch 4
evidence: Compilation C2024C00372 (Register version starting 2024-09-18) is the first to contain s 292A "Who has to prepare annual sustainability reports"; the amending Act's commencement table: "14. Schedules 4 and 5 | The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent. | 18 September 2024". Note to s 292A(1): "For financial years commencing before 1 July 2027, only certain entities are required to prepare a sustainability report: see Part 10.77."
notes: Extract only: the Act is about 6.6 million characters per compilation, so each record holds ss 292A, 296A to 296E and Part 10.77 (the three blocks that carry the sustainability duty and its phase-in), taken unchanged from the compilation's EPUB; fetched_sha256 is the hash of the whole EPUB. Two stored versions: the 2024-09-18 text, and the 2025-12-05 text (compilation C2025C00696, which adds ss 1707DA and 1707DB after the Treasury Laws Amendment (Strengthening Financial Systems and Other Measures) Act 2025, Sch 4 Pt 1, commencing 2025-12-05). The 13 other compilations from 2024-09-18 to 2026-09-19 (listed in SOURCES.md) have identical extracts and are not stored again. Duty applies to financial years starting on or after 2025-01-01 for Group 1 entities.

title: AASB S2 Climate-related Disclosures (Australian Sustainability Reporting Standard, September 2024)
citation: AASB S2 (legislative instrument F2024L01472), made under s 334 of the Corporations Act 2001
evidence: Para Aus37.2: "For legal purposes, this legislative instrument commences on 31 December 2024." Opened the Register EPUB on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only. The standard carries IFRS Foundation copyright and limits reproduction to Professional Use or private study with no derivative works (see AU-AASB-ADOPTED). Mandatory application comes from the Corporations Act, not from this commencement date.
status_note: Row AU-AASB-ADOPTED is permission requested; no text stored.

title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act 2007 (No. 175, 2007)
evidence: Commencement table in the Act as made: "2. Sections 3 to 77 | The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent. | 29 September 2007"; sections 1 and 2 on Royal Assent, 28 September 2007.
notes: The Register lists the as-made version from 2007-09-28; in_force here is the commencement of sections 3 to 77. 27 versions are served; compilation 1 is not in the Register's version list, so the stored consolidated versions start at compilation 2 (2008-09-16).

title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Regulations 2008
notes: The Register lists the as-made version from 2008-06-26 (registration); in_force here is the commencement date in reg 1.02.

title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting (Safeguard Mechanism) Rule 2015
citation: F2015L01637, made under s 22XS(1) of the National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act 2007
notes: The Register lists the as-made version from 2015-10-08 (registration); in_force here is the commencement in s 2. The Safeguard Mechanism Reforms Rules 2023 and later amending rules are folded into the compilations (13 compilations from 2019-03-07 to 2024-08-31).

title: Safeguard Mechanism (Crediting) Amendment Act 2023 (No. 14, 2023)
evidence: Commencement table in the Act as made: "2. Schedules 1, 2 and 3 | The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent. | 12 April 2023"; Schedule 4 Part 2 commenced 4 September 2023 by proclamation (F2023N00250).
notes: Amends the National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act 2007 (safeguard mechanism) and the Climate Change Act 2022 (items 66A to 66F, shown as compilation 1 of that Act from 2023-04-12). One version only.

title: Climate Change Act 2022 (No. 37, 2022)
evidence: Commencement table in the Act as made: "1. The whole of this Act | The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent. | 14 September 2022".
notes: The Register lists the as-made version from 2022-09-13 (Royal Assent); in_force here is the commencement date. Sets the 43% by 2030 and net zero by 2050 targets and the Minister's annual climate change statement; it places no reporting duty on companies.

title: Modern Slavery Act 2018 (No. 153, 2018)
evidence: Commencement table in the Act as made: "2. Sections 3 to 10 and Parts 2 to 4 | A single day to be fixed by Proclamation. ... | 1 January 2019 (F2018N00189)"; sections 1 and 2 on Royal Assent, 10 December 2018.
notes: The Register lists the as-made version from 2018-12-10; in_force here is the proclaimed commencement. Compilations 1 (2024-10-14) and 2 (2024-11-07) follow the Modern Slavery Amendment (Australian Anti-Slavery Commissioner) Act 2024.
